create_SplatData: create a SplatData dataclass instance with xyz, features, opacity, scaling, and rotation arrays
build_transform_data: build a transform pipeline that applies position, rotation, and scale to 3D Gaussian splat data
run_batch_compose_rs: run batch_compose_rs to compose rotation and scale matrices for batched 3D Gaussian splats
run_batch_decompose_rs: run batch_decompose_rs to decompose a combined rotation-scale matrix into separate rotation quaternions and scales
run_batch_rotate_sh: run batch_rotate_sh to rotate spherical harmonic coefficients of 3D Gaussian splats by a rotation matrix
